milestone.title: mp autopilot cycle flow + decision matrix + topology tightening

intent.outcome: A headless mp-owned cycle engine dispatches runner/reviewer assignments, observes durable session events, applies topology-aware decisions, and escalates safely without depending on raul.

problem.description: The herdr runs proved the cycle policy but also exposed fabricated state, overwritten evidence, unclear cycle limits, and role violations. The orchestration engine must own polling, dispatch, verification, lifecycle commands, recovery, and audit events inside mp; depending on a focused TUI would make background drives stall.

in_scope: Headless event loop and typed cycle state machine.
Complete, CycleNext, ShipWithBacklog, and Escalate decision matrix.
Topology cycle budgets, heartbeat liveness, reviewer activation, and next-action prediction.
out_of_scope: Lifecycle and commit transaction closure, moved to the follow-up lifecycle milestone.
Review environment isolation, restart reconciliation, and final end-to-end certification, each moved to dedicated follow-up milestones.

acceptance_criteria.description: The mp-owned headless event loop runs a full Dispatching → WaitingRunner → Reviewing → Deciding → CycleNext cycle from M207 events without raul running; starting or changing raul lanes has no effect on progress.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test cycle_flow_one_cycle --no-fail-fast exit 0 (4/4 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: The decision matrix has explicit Complete, CycleNext, ShipWithBacklog, and Escalate outcomes. A clean reviewer pass returns Complete; low findings may return ShipWithBacklog only in 3-pane policy; high/correctness findings return CycleNext; non-pass at the hard limit returns Escalate.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test decision_matrix_thresholds --no-fail-fast exit 0 (8/8 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Topology tightening consumes M209 policy: 3-pane uses the full matrix and four-cycle maximum, 2-pane forbids ship-with-backlog and uses three cycles, and 1-pane is accepted only for track/trivial sessions with two cycles.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test cycle_topology_tightening --no-fail-fast exit 0 (10/10 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Cycle-cap enforcement treats a clean pass on cycle 4 as Complete and any non-pass requiring continuation on cycle 4 as CycleCapExhausted/Escalate. Blockers-only reviewer mode begins at cycle 2.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test cycle_cap_enforcement --no-fail-fast exit 0 (9/9 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Reviewer activation uses M211 typed dispatch, appends an auditable dispatch event, and carries milestone, cycle, evidence revision, and reviewer actor token.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test cycle_reviewer_activation --no-fail-fast exit 0 (12/12 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: The headless engine uses explicit heartbeat acknowledgements and state timestamps. A responsive lane may remain in the same workflow state without timing out; only missed heartbeat plus stale state produces StaleStateTimeout.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test cycle_stale_state_timeout --no-fail-fast exit 0 (7/7 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: predict_next_action(cycle_state, recent_events) -> NextAction is a pure function with at least 6 named outcomes (DispatchRunner, DispatchReviewer, AwaitRunner, AwaitReviewer, ApplyMatrix, EscalateUser). Returns one of these based on the cycle state machine's current position and last TUI-relay event. The TUI's per-milestone detail view consumes this directly so users can see 'what's next' for each queued milestone.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test cycle_predict_next_action --no-fail-fast exit 0 (12/12 pass)

design_decisions.choice: Pure state machine (states + transitions as data); the dispatcher function consumes events and returns next state + side-effects.
design_decisions.rationale: Same shape as M190's sequencer; tests are deterministic by feeding event sequences.

design_decisions.choice: Tightened prompt (cycle 2 onward: 'blockers only') is a flag passed to the reviewer-activation template; reviewers see `mode=blockers-only` in their prompt.
design_decisions.rationale: Per the log: tightening at cycle 2 catches drift faster than tightening at cycle 3 (M201's experience).

design_decisions.choice: One-pane mode is restricted to tracks/trivial sessions and records a non-independent self-review outcome; full milestones fail preflight unless an explicit recorded bypass policy is supplied.
design_decisions.rationale: A self-review cannot be described as independent verification or as ship without verification.

design_decisions.choice: mp owns orchestration, polling, liveness, recovery, and lifecycle transitions; raul reads session APIs and submits controls but is never in the progress path.
design_decisions.rationale: A TUI-mediated relay stops when the lane is unfocused or the TUI exits, contradicting unattended autopilot behavior.

work_packages.name: Implementation of mp autopilot cycle flow + decision matrix + topology tightening
work_packages.goal: All ACs for mp autopilot cycle flow + decision matrix + topology tightening pass with stamped evidence.
work_packages.rollback: Revert the new module under crates/mp/src/autopilot/cycle.rs to the pre-milestone state; plan-zone changes roll back via git.

steps.action: Implement and verify: The cycle-flow state machine runs through one full cycle (Dispatching → WaitingRunner → Reviewing → Deciding → cycle-next → Dispatching) for an in-test milestone with stubbed lane notifications.
steps.done_when: AC-01 evidence is stamped via `mp milestone criterion pass 213 AC-01 --evidence`.

steps.action: Implement and verify: The decision matrix returns the documented outcome for representative inputs: `high_severity + cycle=1 → CycleNext`; `low_count<=2 + cycle=2 → ShipWithBacklog`; `cycle=4 → Escalate`.
steps.done_when: AC-02 evidence is stamped via `mp milestone criterion pass 213 AC-02 --evidence`.

steps.action: Implement and verify: Cycle-cap enforcement: synthetic 4-cycle milestone reaches `Escalate` even if all prior verdicts were `Pass`. Soft-cap kicks in at cycle 2 (tightened-reviewer-prompt flag).
steps.done_when: AC-04 evidence is stamped via `mp milestone criterion pass 213 AC-04 --evidence`.
